additional_info.subject: Re: ID0422404-DC/Si-D/DE-{MP / S8 170003981}column has hung CRM:02681000142
additional_info.body:
Hallo
Michael Frenger,
As checked in Logs from
2025-05-05T16:41:51.713223 UTC to 2025-05-05T17:16:50.244094 below are the observations:
1) Session started at 2025-05-05T16:41:51.713223 which was authorized via credit card was terminated due to no communication established between charger & Vehicle (No EVCCID Identified)
Authorized at 2025-05-05T16:41:51.713223
Gun Connect
ed at
2025-05-05T16:42:16.631187
error generated at
2025-05-05T16:43:10.070582+00:00
The communication between EVCC & SECC should be done withing 20S but here it exceeds 54S
2)Session started at
2025-05-05T16:44:18.353504
which was authorized via RFID with ID:
084A6E95
immediately after the 1st RFID was scanned, 4 MORE  RFID WERE SCANNED & SESISON was terminated from OCPP backend as Invalid Authorization
3)
Session started at
2025-05-05T16:44:23.358295
which was authorized via RFID with
ID:
0830768E
Gun Connect
ed at
2025-05-05T16:45:27.057291
error generated at
2025-05-05T16:45:37.039004
Authorization to Gun connection the process to be done within 60s , but here time exceeds 60s delayed in Gun Connection as result session was stopped.
4)
Session started at
2025-05-05T16:46:22.507740
which was authorized via RFID with ID:
08651927
immediately after the 1st RFID was scanned, 4 MORE  RFID WERE SCANNED & SESISON was terminated from OCPP backend as Invalid Authorization
5) Charger Reboot command was send at
2025-05-05T16:52:51.412521
6) S
ession started at 2025-05-05T16:41:51.713223 which was authorized via credit card IDTag:
EMVS*64227165*002047
Vehicle Connect
ed at
2025-05-05T16:45:27.057291( Within 60s:OK)
all the remaining process were done properly & so session was successfully started & succesful charging session was performed.
Summary: Either there is delay between Authorization & Vehicle connection or Backend is not Authorizing RFID or CCS2 plug is not connecting properly with vehicle.
If the problem appears again please do let us know the time frame of the issue.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
